waypoints.advice: Chéticamp is the fuel stop for this leg. Next is French Mountain, climbing 445 m.

waypoints.name: French Mountain
waypoints.advice: 455 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 445 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Pleasant Bay, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Pleasant Bay
waypoints.advice: Pleasant Bay closes the day. You lose 435 m on the way down to it, steadily.

sections.advice: Baddeck → Chéticamp is 78 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

French Mountain → Pleasant Bay drops about 435 m over 13 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Chéticamp → French Mountain
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 46 km. 445 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: 27 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

cabot-trail-highlands-loop-part-1.story: French Mountain is the high point. The plan has 1 fuel stop marked.
